description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`), played apart from the cases. `hovered-card-race` is refused by `race/read-after-action` at `card.spec.ts:13`, and here it is pinned to its own refusal with the site its neighbour `toast-tone-race` holds, `toast.spec.ts:20`, in the middle — the drift a pinned message exists to catch, placed so that its first and last lines are the case's own and only the whole pin tells the two apart. The runner has to report it, and nothing of the case as written or pinned to its own `message`. It has to report each variant besides, every one a rule no prepared case can prove, since every case is built to fire its own point alone: over `_reference`, a case that passed; over `_two-points`, its race beside the paused sheen's bare wait, a case that fired more than it declares — the race comes first, so only that rule reports it; with `check` set to `baseline`, another check; with `rule` set to `wait-then-baseline`, another rule.
